summary: Master Cold Chain Logistics and Temperature-Controlled Supply Chains with hands-on training in IoT monitoring, lane qualification, and regulatory compliance. En
lede: Cold chain logistics training prepares intermediate supply chain professionals to manage temperature-sensitive products across storage and transport. It covers temperature mapping, refrigerated route planning, excursion-risk assessment, and sensor-dashboard monitoring, alongside audit documentation and performance reporting to help teams protect product integrity and make evidence-based operational decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for intermediate-level professionals who manage, coordinate, or audit temperature-controlled supply chains in food, pharmaceutical, or biotech sectors. Participants should have 2-5 years of supply chain experience and basic familiarity with Excel for data analysis. No coding required. The programme is ideal for those seeking to bridge the gap between operational knowledge and evidence-based cold chain management systems aligned with global standards. Cold Chain Operations Manager:
audience: Oversee temperature-controlled storage and transport networks
Supply Chain Risk Analyst: Assess climate-vulnerable routes
Regulatory Compliance Officer: Ensure WHO/FDA/HACCP adherence
Pharmaceutical Logistics Specialist: Handle high-value vaccine
Food Safety Auditor: Verify HACCP compliance
Sustainability Manager: Implement ISO 14001-aligned energy-efficient refrigeration
IT Systems Integrator: Deploy IoT smart sensors
Procurement Manager: Source climate-resilient suppliers and negotiate
modules: Cold Chain Fundamentals and Industry Drivers
Digital Transformation: IoT, Blockchain, and AI Integration
Sustainable and Energy-Efficient Cold Chain Operations
Performance Measurement, Reporting, and Strategic Roadmapping
Capstone: Integrated Cold Chain Management Simulation
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of supply chain processes and experience in planning or operations roles. Familiarity with Excel and basic data analysis is advantageous. No coding or advanced technical skills required. Bring your organization's current cold chain challenges to discuss during capstone exercises.
